latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Generate 1080p AI videos directly from text prompts, with seamless file upload and export.

- Upload TXT, DOCX, PDF, or plain text files up to 500MB and convert them into MP4 videos.
- One-step prompt input: Describe a scene and instantly generate high-quality videos without manual editing.
- Automatic token and session management for easy onboarding (no account needed for free credits).
- Live status updates during connection, upload, and rendering.
- Download completed videos in common formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, and more).
- Built for fast, frictionless content creation—no editing skills or extra tools required.
